observations.description: A wide shot of the football pitch shows players in white and red jerseys moving across the field. The scoreboard at the top left reads 'UAE 0 - 1 OMA' with the match clock around 46:54. A player in a white jersey passes the ball forward towards the opponent's goal area.

A player in a white jersey receives a pass near the penalty area and takes a shot. The ball flies past the goalkeeper in a yellow jersey into the net. The scoreboard updates to 'UAE 1 - 1 OMA' at 75:59. The crowd in the stands, mostly wearing white, erupts in celebration, waving flags and cheering.
